summary: Iteration 47 — Phase 3 (Marketing Mailchimp + Partner Evaluation + Message Groups). Backend pytest: 12/20 passed. Mailchimp (7/7) and Partner Evaluation (5/5) working perfectly. MESSAGE GROUPS (0/8) is completely broken due to CRITICAL FastAPI route shadowing bug — all /api/messages/groups* endpoints defined at lines 5378-5470 are unreachable because /api/messages/{conversation_id} (lines 4010/4017) is registered earlier and matches 'groups' as the conversation_id path param. POST /api/messages/groups returns 200 with a garbage message object {conversation_id:'groups', text:'', sender_id:...} instead of creating a group. GET/PUT/DELETE behave similarly. Frontend: All UI elements render correctly (Marketing ping shows MARSOL GROUP us18 MMS with 2 audiences and 50 campaigns; TEST_Draft campaign I created is visible in list; Partner Evaluation page shows Up holding ranked #1 with scores object + Standart tier; Messages page has new-group-btn + modal with member checkboxes + create-group-btn). However clicking 'Yarat' in the group modal will hit the broken backend route so the feature is non-functional end-to-end.

critical.issue: FastAPI route shadowing: the catch-all /api/messages/{conversation_id} defined at server.py line 4010 (GET) and 4017 (POST) is matched BEFORE /api/messages/groups (lines 5378, 5388). POST /api/messages/groups with body {name,members} returns 200 with a message object (conversation_id='groups', sender_id=..., text='') instead of creating a group. Feature totally non-functional. FIX: move lines 5376-5475 (MESSAGE GROUPS block) to BEFORE line 4010, OR rename the group routes to /api/message-groups (and update Messages.jsx accordingly). Also note group message sub-routes /api/messages/groups/{group_id}/messages work only incidentally because path has 3 segments — but GET/POST on /api/messages/groups itself are shadowed.

minor.issue: Returns 200 for successful draft creation — consider 201 per REST conventions. Not blocking.
Accepts literal 'groups' as a conversation_id and creates implicit empty message on POST — permissive validation masks the shadowing bug above. Consider rejecting reserved keyword.

integration_issues.issue: UI modal opens and is fully wired with data-testids (new-group-btn, create-group-btn, members checkboxes), BUT the backend POST /api/messages/groups is shadowed so submission will silently fail (or create an empty chat message instead). End-to-end group creation is broken until backend route order is fixed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 4010/4017 — /api/messages/{conversation_id} uses an unconstrained Path parameter which shadows any later concrete /messages/* route. Best practice: register all concrete paths before catch-alls OR add a Pydantic/Regex constraint like conversation_id: str = Path(..., regex='^(?!groups$).+$').

server.py line 5270+ — partner evaluation math is sound: payment ratio clamp [0,1]*40, meetings capped at 10, manual clamp [0,5]. GET /partner-evaluation computes synchronously across ALL active companies in a loop with per-company sub-queries (contracts, invitations, sales_leads, meetings, partner_evaluations = 5 queries each). For 2000 companies that is 10k serial queries — will be very slow at scale. Consider $lookup aggregation pipeline or batch pre-fetch.
mailchimp_service.py — clean async client with BasicAuth and datacenter extraction. Error handling is consistent ({ok:bool,error:str,raw:dict}). Good.

server.py line 5201-5202 — contact_first_name fallback uses `or owner_name.split()[0] if owner_name else ''` but Python operator precedence means `(a or b.split()[0]) if c else ''` → when `c` (owner_name) is empty string (falsy) the whole expression returns '' even if contact_first_name is set. Minor edge-case bug; rewrite as explicit if/else.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: in FastAPI/Starlette, routes are matched in registration order. The file server.py registers /api/messages/{conversation_id} at line 4010 (GET) and 4017 (POST) BEFORE registering /api/messages/groups at line 5378 (GET) and 5388 (POST). When a request hits /api/messages/groups, the dynamic path {conversation_id} captures the string 'groups' and the concrete route never runs. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BASE/api/messages/groups -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -d '{"name":"x","members":["only-one"]}'` → HTTP 200, response body `{"id":"<uuid>","conversation_id":"groups","sender_id":"<admin id>","text":"","created_at":"..."}` — proves the request was routed to the message-send endpoint, not group-create. Mitigation: move the MESSAGE GROUPS route block (lines 5376-5475) above line 4010, or change prefix to /api/message-groups (and update frontend Messages.jsx fetch URLs).
